old_caption: The video showcases a series of vibrant gemstones, each with distinct colors and facets, arranged against a soft, blurred background that enhances their brilliance. The gems include a large pink gemstone, a smaller blue gemstone, and a red gemstone, all reflecting light and creating a sparkling effect. The camera slowly zooms in on these stones, capturing their intricate cuts and the way they refract light, emphasizing their clarity and sparkle. The overall effect is one of elegance and luxury, highlighting the beauty and value of these precious stones.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a series of vibrant gemstones, each with distinct colors and facets, arranged against a soft, blurred background that enhances their brilliance. The gems include a large pink diamond, a smaller blue diamond, and a red gemstone, all reflecting light and creating a sparkling effect. The camera pans around these stones, capturing their intricate cuts and the way they refract light, emphasizing their clarity and sparkle. As the camera moves, it reveals more of the surrounding gems, which are similarly cut and polished, adding depth to the scene. The overall effect is one of elegance and luxury, highlighting the beauty and value of these precious stones.
caption: The video showcases a close-up, brightly lit view of three faceted gemstones on a glossy white surface, with out-of-focus stones blurred in the background. A blue cut diamond sits at the left, a colorless diamond near the top, and a pink-red oval gem at the right, each catching star-shaped glints on its facets. The viewpoint slowly orbits and tilts toward a top-down angle, rounding the pink gem's silhouette from an elongated oval into a fuller circle while the blue diamond appears to stand upright. As the camera drifts, the clear stone shifts behind the blue one and the blurred red shape at the lower edge swells into prominence. New glints migrate across the facets, tracking the changing light against the polished stones.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
